title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 17, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B9.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.7 (Peaked October 17, 2026 at 15:40 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C6.0 (Peaked October 16, 2026 at 19:14 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 455 km/s (Elevated)
🧲 Bz: +7.3 nT (Northward)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

Small flare, but Sunny noticed! 🔥🌎

Today’s solar images show two sunspot groups, bright active regions, and a prominent elongated dark structure across the lower-central Sun.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
